title.en: David Ellison lands Warner Bros. for $81 billion. Who gets to tell the next story?
title.zh: 大卫·埃里森拿下华纳：810亿美元，买到了谁的故事？

summary.en: Paramount completed the acquisition on October 6. The $81 billion is equity value; $110 billion is enterprise value. CNN and CBS News now share a corporate parent; editorial outcomes remain uncertain.
summary.zh: 派拉蒙于10月6日完成收购。810亿美元是股权价值，1100亿美元是企业价值。CNN与CBS新闻同属一家母公司；编辑独立与整合结果仍待观察。

title.en: Francis Halzen put a cubic kilometre of ice to work. What did it catch?
title.zh: 哈尔岑把一立方公里南极冰变成望远镜：到底抓到了什么？

summary.en: The October 6 physics Nobel recognises Halzen’s role in IceCube and high-energy cosmic neutrinos. An international team turns rare interactions into a new view of the universe.
summary.zh: 10月6日物理诺奖表彰哈尔岑对IceCube及高能宇宙中微子的贡献。国际团队借极罕见的粒子相互作用，打开新的宇宙观测窗口。
